title: Write useful image words
summary: Alternative text describes a useful image for someone who cannot see it.
introduction: Alternative text describes a useful image for someone who cannot see it. Your task: Write a short alt description for a photo in your own project.
learningObjectives: Write a short alt description for a photo in your own project.
Explain the example for write useful image words

blocks.text: Alternative text describes a useful image for someone who cannot see it. Decorative images use an empty alt value.

Try runnable HTML here with a keyboard as well as a mouse. A screen reader is a tool that reads page information aloud. Test real pages with people and tools; one automated check cannot prove everything works.

blocks.title: Write useful image words

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: An empty `alt` asks reading tools to skip a decorative image. Use meaningful alternative text when a picture adds information.

blocks.text: A screen reader can describe the seedling and skip the decorative corner flower.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not use file names as alt text. If an image is a control, describe its action or use a labelled button.
